title: DILG chief: Atong Ang may have left PH 'backdoor' a year ago

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said he has been receiving information about gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang leaving the country through the “backdoor” since last year. Remulla only revealed the update on Tuesday due to the process of verification. “The information has been under our analysis for one year,” Remulla told Inquirer in a Viber message on Wednesday. “Validation takes a while. Upon taking all the intelligence reports, our theory is that he has left the country,” the secretary noted. “Much of the information came from his former cohorts who have turned state witness,” Remulla added.
